cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.4.2)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "")
set(_CMAKE_CHECK_ENABLED_LANGUAGES "C;CXX")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "/usr/bin/cc")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID "GNU")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LOADED 1)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_VERSION "13.3.0")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "/usr/bin/c++")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID "GNU")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LOADED 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION "13.3.0")

project(CheckASM LANGUAGES ASM)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/result.cmake" "set(CMAKE_ASM_COMPILER \"${CMAKE_ASM_COMPILER}\")
")
